agreement.frozen_evaluation: Three paired training replicates on the retained terminal-safety q1 corpus; fresh development arenas only; no locked-final evaluation or promotion.
hypotheses: All-legal-action public heuristic ranking pretraining improves the final MC candidate relative to a matched MC-only control.
Ranking preserves the q1 parent gain while avoiding the heuristic non-regression failure.
Any heuristic-opponent improvement may be teacher imitation and requires direct treatment-control, parent, random, seat, and safety guardrails.
agreement.operational_repair: The original frozen run failed after valid replicate-1 artifacts because a TYPE_CHECKING-only Tensor name was evaluated by typing.cast at runtime. Repair source 2de410b imports Tensor locally in the optional RL load path and adds a regression round-trip test. The repaired run restarts from the same fixed inputs, recipes, seeds, arena sizes, and decision criteria; original partial artifacts are validation evidence only and are not used for claims.
agreement.question: On the exact retained terminal-safety q1 corpus, does an information-safe heuristic candidate-ranking warm start improve the subsequent selected-action Monte Carlo candidate relative to an otherwise identical MC-only control?
agreement.reserved_decisions: Fresh corpus collection, mixed-opponent replay, locked-final evaluation, promotion, recipe changes, larger budgets, and external retention require new user approval.
agreement.why_it_matters: This isolates target/action-ordering coverage on the first retained failure corpus before changing data collection, representation, or capacity.
